planning.voiceReason: A persuasive offer tests the crew’s judgment and shared budget.
planning.earlyCare: Jon protects the money neighbours earned at the stall.

planning.dramaticChange: Jon trades a triumphant accusation for a patient explanation a learner can check.
sceneActivities: Jon studies a decorative golden fitting while Ryn inspects the material record; they refuse the unsupported offer.

actingSignature.Jonathan: Self-directed humour and practical questions; open palms become quiet attention when corrected.
actingSignature.Min: Worries about appearances but now asks whose needs a decision serves; gentle teasing.
actingSignature.Tavi: Proud practical cook; starts defending her stall, then corrects the sign without excuses.
actingSignature.Orr: Smooth confident vendor; evasive when asked for checkable evidence.
actingSignature.Ryn: Specific technical limits, insists on matching materials to inspected requirements.
actingSignature.Sela: Patient questions that require plain explanations rather than impressive language.

planning.freshQuestion: A newly introduced resident couple prepares an opening display of community photographs and memories. continuation.end: Jon, Ryn, Min and Sela reject Orr’s unsupported instant-repair promise and decorative upgrade. The sample is returned. Approved materials are purchased with documented supplies funds; qualified pipe and roof specialists complete their respective repairs over several days and sign off on their work. Final safety inspection is still pending, so the centre remains closed. Repair test water came from the specialists; all historical drinking-water balances and memories are unchanged. The next task is preparing opening-day photographs while awaiting inspection.

artwork.prompt: Create a wide 16:9 Chinese ink-wash illustration of the friendly bearded adult man in the reference, keeping his recognizable short tousled hair, broad face, sturdy build, cream tunic and brown robe. He sits quietly at a wooden workbench, thoughtfully comparing a decorative golden plumbing fitting in his hand with a plain one on the table. One person, waist-up view, face clearly visible. Traditional brush-and-ink aesthetic on ivory paper: flowing black contours, soft gray washes, dry brush texture, abundant empty paper, and a tiny muted gold accent on the fitting. Spare brush strokes suggest a courtyard in the background. Asymmetrical composition with the man toward the left and open paper to the right. Gentle, thoughtful atmosphere. No lettering or logos. Make the entire image a brush painting rather than a realistic photograph.
